accepted_findings.decision: Use Apple's system trust store instead of certificate pinning.
accepted_findings.rationale: Pensieve talks to user-selected AI providers. Pinning provider certificates would break endpoint choice and certificate rotation while adding no stable trust boundary for this product.

accepted_findings.decision: Canonical metadata is not an executable subresource.
accepted_findings.rationale: The canonical link declares the preferred document URL and neither fetches nor executes third-party content, so subresource integrity does not apply.
